dataset.name: UK Software Developer Demo
dataset.description: Fully synthetic UK software-development vacancies for non-production tests and demonstrations.

jobs.title: Java Software Developer
jobs.description: Join a fictional product team building accessible workflow tools with Java and Spring Boot. The synthetic role includes API design, automated testing, SQL data modelling, code review and supportive collaboration with Angular developers.

jobs.title: Backend Developer
jobs.description: A fictional engineering group needs a backend developer to shape small Java services, improve PostgreSQL queries and maintain Docker-based development workflows. The synthetic vacancy values secure design, dependable tests and constructive peer review.

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs.description: Build a fictional case-management product across Angular, TypeScript and Spring Boot. This entirely synthetic position covers user-focused interface work, REST integration, unit and integration testing, and incremental delivery with a multidisciplinary team.

jobs.title: Junior Software Developer
jobs.description: This fictional junior role supports a friendly delivery team maintaining Java applications and documented REST APIs. The synthetic work includes pairing, small bug fixes, automated tests, Git-based review and structured learning without fees or paid training claims.

jobs.title: Angular Developer
jobs.description: A wholly fictional remote team is improving an Angular and TypeScript interface for workflow reporting. The synthetic vacancy focuses on accessible components, predictable state, API integration, browser tests and clear collaboration with backend engineers.

jobs.title: Spring Boot Developer
jobs.description: Develop fictional Spring Boot services for a small internal platform, with emphasis on authorization boundaries, input validation and repeatable CI. This synthetic role also covers observability, API contracts, refactoring and shared ownership of production-quality tests.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: Work on a fictional remote-first software platform using Java, relational data and carefully bounded cloud integrations. The synthetic position includes design discussions, troubleshooting, performance measurement, threat-aware development and pragmatic automated testing.

jobs.title: API Developer
jobs.description: A fictional London product group is designing stable REST APIs and generated client contracts. This synthetic role involves Java implementation, OpenAPI review, negative-path integration tests, compatibility checks and concise technical documentation for consumers.

jobs.title: Platform Software Developer
jobs.description: Help a fictional platform team simplify developer tooling with Java services and Docker-based local environments. The synthetic vacancy covers health checks, structured logs, CI reliability, dependency maintenance and calm incident-oriented problem solving.
